summary.name: Apidog
summary.one_liner: Apidog is an all-in-one API platform for designing OpenAPI specs, debugging requests, running automated tests, generating mocks, and publishing API documentation.
use_cases: generate mock endpoints for frontend work
build automated integration tests from a spec
import existing Postman or Swagger collections
summary.what_it_does:
Apidog lets users design OpenAPI (Swagger) specs visually with JSON Schema support, reusable components, and branch-based collaboration. It works as an HTTP client that sends requests and validates responses against the API spec, with reusable endpoint cases for regression checks. Its visual automated testing turns specs into integration tests and supports loops, branching, and data flow. It also generates zero-config mock endpoints from a spec, which can be refined with rules or scripts, and publishes interactive documentation with versioning, custom domains, and Try It Out. The page says it can import more than 15 formats, including Postman, OpenAPI/Swagger, Insomnia, HAR, JMeter, RAML, and WSDL.</what_it_does>
